overview.description: The KraneShares Public-Private Emerging Markets Internet and Technology ETF (KEMQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is now an actively managed fund, investing in emerging market internet and technology companies, both public and private. Holdings are based on an index of the 50 largest eligible companies by market capitalization, weighted by rank. KEMQ was launched on Oct 11, 2017 and is issued by KraneShares.
